data: Which line is the lowest at the beginning of the graph in the bottom-right figure (labeled 'Portuguese')?

The question asks which line is the lowest at the beginning of the graph in the bottom-right figure labeled 'Portuguese'. From the caption, we know that the x-axis is log-scaled. The lines represent different models: NMT-1 (green dashed line), NMT-2 (blue dotted line), cSMTiser+LM (red solid line), and Norma (orange dashed line). 

Looking at the bottom-right figure (f), we can see that the green dashed line (NMT-1) starts at the lowest point compared to the other lines. Therefore, the line representing NMT-1 is the lowest at the beginning of the graph in the bottom-right figure.
